What causes most earthen dam failures?
Probable Maximum Flood — theoretical maximum for high-hazard dam design
Slow water velocity → sediment settles; trap efficiency >95% for large reservoirs
What is a levee's biggest risk factor?
False security leads to floodplain development; failure of designed protection → catastrophic
What is the difference between detention and retention?
Detention: stores water, releases slowly; Retention: permanently stores water (infiltration/ET)
Manage stormwater where it falls — infiltration, ET, retention — vs. pipe and discharge
H-W for pressure pipe (closed conduit); Manning for open channels (gravity flow)
